items.text: BSc forestry career options include forest department recruitment routes, conservation and wildlife organisations, wood and plantation industries, GIS and remote sensing work, environmental consulting and further study, and many roles are location based and competitive.
Choose between public service, conservation, industry and mapping routes, build field and GIS proof and check official recruitment rules.
Verify eligibility on official notices and never pay agents for posts.
